quantize_4bit: quantize a PyTorch tensor to 4-bit using fp4 or nf4 quantization types on MPS
dequantize_4bit: dequantize a 4-bit quantized PyTorch tensor back to full precision on MPS
dequantize_4bit_out: dequantize a 4-bit tensor into an existing output tensor on MPS
gemv_4bit: perform matrix-vector multiplication with 4-bit quantized weights on MPS
gemv_4bit_out: perform matrix-vector multiplication with 4-bit weights into an output tensor on MPS
